question: Which coordinate domains does K01 use for map cells, exact placement, entity locomotion, movement accumulation/commit, and projectile start/end/route points, and which closed subset can be converted explicitly to semantic GridPoint?

coordinateDomains.storage: map byte fields indexed by x*180+y; x/y are signed WORD arguments
coordinateDomains.scale: 1 cell per integer index; no pixel or iso scale asserted
coordinateDomains.anchor: logical cell index only; geometric/pixel anchor unknown
coordinateDomains.conversion: explicit identity to/from semantic GridPoint only for integer in-bounds K01 cells

coordinateDomains.storage: signed WORD origin plus signed WORD descriptor offset, wrapped to signed WORD before bounds
coordinateDomains.width: signed WORD coordinate pair; K01 map bounds 0..59
coordinateDomains.anchor: record x/y anchor; only native mobile classes 12/13/14/82 have proven 1x1 footprint

provenRange.outOfBoundsPolicy: allocate/update age first, skip create, continue descriptor loop

coordinateDomains.conversion: explicit identity to/from semantic GridPoint only after signed-WORD sum and in-bounds check

coordinateDomains.storage: entity WORD +0x1bc/+0x1be current pair, +0x4ee raw input, +0x4ea cadence limit, +0x4f2 accumulator; signed arithmetic in recovered branch
coordinateDomains.width: 16-bit WORD storage; signed interpretation where compare/division is proven
coordinateDomains.unit: source locomotion field; coordinate unit and world-cell displacement unknown
coordinateDomains.anchor: current/next record fields only; interpolation/output helper semantics unknown
coordinateDomains.conversion: fail-closed: no semantic GridPoint conversion until source unit/producer/consumer mapping is statically closed

coordinateDomains.storage: entity WORD +0x4f2; raw WORD +0x4ee is transformed only for selector BYTE +0xba == 1
coordinateDomains.unit: accumulator threshold units, not a confirmed cell or pixel distance
coordinateDomains.scale: raw selector-1 transform raw-trunc(raw/3); otherwise raw; no fixed-time scale
coordinateDomains.anchor: commit snapshots +0x1bc/+0x1be to +0x1cc/+0x1ce and copies +0x4d8/+0x4da to current pair
consumers: same function's signed threshold and current-pair commit
coordinateDomains.conversion: fail-closed: accumulator is not a GridPoint and current pair's source unit is unresolved

coordinateDomains.storage: projectile record signed WORD start/end/current fields and signed WORD[160] route arrays
coordinateDomains.width: source record fields are signed WORD; independent accepted route subset is 0..32767 per coordinate
coordinateDomains.unit: integer route coordinate; route index is signed WORD and route sample interval is 14
coordinateDomains.scale: integer Bresenham-style arithmetic; no rounding or product scale conversion
coordinateDomains.anchor: route index 0 stores start; final route index is compared for arrival; endpoint is copied from target +0x32/+0x34
coordinateDomains.conversion: fail-closed: source route scale and semantic GridPoint mapping are not statically proven

exactTransforms: map storage ordinal = x*180+y (x-major); no rounding
placement coordinate = signedWord(origin + signedWord(offset)); bounds are checked after allocation
selector BYTE +0xba == 1: raw - trunc(raw/3) toward zero; other selector values retain raw
movement accumulator stores signed-WORD sum, clamps negative-to-positive crossing to zero, commits at >=50, then subtracts 100
projectile route uses integer Bresenham-style stepping and retains every 14th point, with route index 0 as start
semantic GridPoint conversion is identity only for in-bounds map cell and exact placement coordinates
nonTransforms: No universal scale combines map cells, placement records, locomotion fields, and projectile route words.
No pixel, iso.ts, render output, clamping, or Math.round value is used as original-coordinate evidence.
No locomotion or projectile source coordinate is promoted to semantic GridPoint without a proven scale/anchor.
Negative, unsigned-32768, signed-32767, and overflowed sums fail closed outside each accepted contract.

acceptedStep: FUN_0048d6f0 (timer resolver; before K01 stage updater)
FUN_0048a5c0 (stage 1 K01 updater, only on distinct tick and no prior result)
FUN_0043c9c0 (once per active entity record in the pass)
C01.scope: accepted source-update order and count only; raw clock→project tick and identity policy unresolved

E01.projectile: projectile pool and source-entity handle references remain distinct pools

proposedAdapter.name: analysis-only-k01-source-coordinate-bridge
proposedAdapter.input: Tagged source coordinate domain; map dimensions and explicit direction (sourceToSemantic or semanticToSource)
proposedAdapter.output: Tagged semantic GridPoint for map-cell/exact-placement accepted subset, or an explicit rejection reason
accepted: placement signed-WORD origin+offset after wrap and in-bounds check
rejected: locomotion current/raw fields until source unit is proven
projectile route values until source scale/anchor is proven
fractional, rounded, clamped, or pixel coordinates

direction.sourceToSemantic: identity only in accepted map/placement subset
direction.semanticToSource: identity only for integer in-bounds GridPoint; otherwise reject

proposedAdapter.rounding: none; any requested rounding is an explicit contract error
proposedAdapter.anchor: logical cell anchor only; no ground-contact or pixel anchor
proposedAdapter.implementation: not implemented; no production package/app change

codeAnchors.meaning: map projection admits signed x/y only inside map dimensions
map projection writes the separate (x-y)<<5 and (x+y)<<4 base pair
placement reader loads the object byte from the x-major map field
placement reader forms the frame-byte field address
class-2 normal movement reads raw WORD +0x4ee
class-2 normal movement stores the signed-WORD accumulator
coordinate commit is admitted only at signed accumulator >= 50
coordinate commit writes next X to current +0x1bc
projectile route stores signed-WORD start X/Y at route index zero and retains the 160-point cap
projectile update compares current route index with final route index
Ryu spawn reads the active target signed WORD endpoint fields
native placement checks signed coordinate bounds after allocation
entity initializer writes slot, generation, and exact signed x/y fields
